{"reason": "All 4 stockouts (195000 each) come from branch 2's suggest-alternative-supplier, and cost 2165000=35000+30*45000+4*195000. alert-planner (35000, always on time) dominates alt-supplier (45000, late risk). Redirecting branch 2 to alert-planner cuts cost to 1825000 and stockouts 4->0 (fitness -2.565->-1.825); gate holds.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
